title: Discord Presence Failure Rate
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=discord:presence
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(presence_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by activity_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Discord presence records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each activity.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize presence_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per activity.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It follows which parts of your Discord presence data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
